ASSAM_GUIDE.name: By air
ASSAM_GUIDE.about: Gopinath Bordoloi Airport (GAU), Guwahati — the gateway with direct flights to Delhi, Kolkata and Mumbai.

ASSAM_GUIDE.name: By rail
ASSAM_GUIDE.about: Guwahati railway station connects to Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai and the North East via the far-east line.

ASSAM_GUIDE.name: By road
ASSAM_GUIDE.about: Assam is linked to the rest of India by the Grand Trunk Road and National Highway 27; the river links the interiors.

ASSAM_GUIDE.name: Best season
ASSAM_GUIDE.about: October to March — cool, clear and ideal for rhino safaris; April brings the Rongali Bihu.

ASSAM_GUIDE.name: Inside the state
ASSAM_GUIDE.about: Buses, taxis and the river ferries move people between the districts; a private car is the easiest way.

ASSAM_GUIDE.name: Where to stay
ASSAM_GUIDE.about: From Kaziranga forest camps to Guwahati hotels and Majuli satra cottages — as booked through the Journey planner.
